title: Collaborative Privacy-Preserving Artificial Intelligence — Federated Zero-Knowledge Machine Learning
extraction_method: Google Docs get_document; depth-first body/table paragraphs in tab t.0, concatenate textRun.content in document order, UTF-8 without normalization. Native equation elements contribute no text.

native_equations.reason: Docs returned equation:{} with UTF-16 ranges, without formula contents.

inspection_scope: All chapter/exercise headings indexed; selected M0 and transcript prose and 20 native equation elements inspected. Neither all prose nor all mathematics is reviewed.
snapshot_policy: Observed revision, text-only digest and private authorized export digest identify this inspection. No complete immutable manuscript snapshot is published; inspect remaining source mathematics before source-dependent promotion.
publication_rights: undecided; manuscript excluded from Apache-2.0 software distribution
source_access: Use connected Google Docs with owner-granted access. No local manuscript path is assumed.
